description: Department of Commerce - Approved Credit Agency under the Mortgage Act, Trust Receipt Ordinance and Inland Trust Receipts Act
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of an institution as an "Approved Credit Agency" under specific legislative acts (The Mortgage Act, The Trust Receipts Ordinance, and The Inland Trust Receipts Act). The notification is made by a government official exercising powers vested by these laws, making it primarily about regulatory implementation rather than government personnel changes or organizational structure. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it concerns the application and enforcement of existing legislation.
